metadata.case_name: CHOY CHUNG SHING v. DR. NG HON CHUN

plaintiff.occupation_before: master in the trade of vehicle and machinery repair

injuries.description: injection into the left buttock ... damaged the Plaintiff's sciatic nerve, causing him permanent injuries
source: The Defendant, a medical practitioner, administered an injection into the left buttock of the Plaintiff on 11th January 1996 which damaged the Plaintiff's sciatic nerve, causing him permanent injuries.
Regarding the Plaintiff's left leg, it was found, inter alia, that there was general muscle wasting, discolouration and cyanosis, and unhealthy skin which was sensitive to touch.
Regarding his left ankle and foot, general tissue shrinkage in the area, obvious drop-foot deformity, weak muscle power, and marked impaired pain and touch sense.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of sciatic nerve at hip or thigh level

manifestations.description: pain and other unpleasant sensations over his left leg and foot
weakness and wasting of the leg, calf and foot muscles
general muscle wasting, discolouration and cyanosis, and unhealthy skin which was sensitive to touch
marked impaired pain and touch sense in left ankle and foot
walked with a limp and had fallen twice before the accident
itchiness over the area of the injured nerve disturbing his sleep
must permanently wear an ankle support to prevent his ankle from turning over

treatments_received: treatment at Chung Sen Medical College (CSMC)
consultations with bonesetter Ng Po Shui
treatments_future: regular symptomatic treatments at Princess Margaret Hospital (PWH)

losses.description: disability which mars general activities and enjoyment of life; reduced leg function, muscle wasting and sensory impairment
walked with a limp and had fallen twice; needs to wear ankle support to prevent ankle turning over

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: reduced sex life as a result of the injury
